name: The Knight in the Area
plot:
Kakeru and Suguru are brothers who both have a flaming passion for soccer. However, while Suguru becomes a rising star in the Japanese youth soccer system, Kakeru decides to take on a managerial role after struggling on the field. But due to a cruel twist of fate, Kakeru ends up reevaluating the role he has chosen.

In hopes of one day being able to enter the World Cup by becoming a member of the national team, Kakeru trains harder than anyone else. He isn’t alone in this quest for glory, though. Kakeru's childhood friend, Nana, is a soccer prodigy of her own, with the wicked nickname “Little Witch”. She is a top-ranked player and is already playing for Nadeshiko Japan, the Japanese women’s national team. Nana's success gives Kakeru the extra push he needs to reach for his goals.

name: خليل الله
plot: تدور أحداث مسلسل خليل الله حول حياة النبي إبراهيم بما في ذلك بعض الأنبياء المعاصرين له، عليهم السلام ..وقد نشأ وسط  مجتمع كان يعبد الأصنام وكان والده من أمهر صناع التماثيل و الأصنام آنذاك.و قد ألهمه الله تعالى و أقنعه بالفطرة بأن أباه و أهله كانوا في ضلال مبين  الشيء الذي أدى إلى المواجهة ليس فقط مع الأب والمجتمع، ولكن أيضا مع الملك النمرود، الذي يعتبر نفسه إلها

plot: Qiao Yan’s life changes overnight when her parents die in a car accident, leaving her an orphan. Soon after, Gu Changfeng, the powerful chairman of the Gu Corporation and a man claiming to be her grandfather, takes her back to China. Though reluctant, Qiao Yan suspects foul play in her parents’ deaths and begins investigating within the Gu family. There, she encounters Gu Jingyuan, her cold and indifferent “uncle.” Playing the role of a fragile orphan, she tries to win his trust, but a hidden battle of wits unfolds between them. Just as she suspects him of murder, Gu Jingyuan saves her from danger and vows to protect her and the family. Their bond deepens into a forbidden love, tested by countless trials and the patriarch’s opposition. When they finally choose to defy everything for love, a greater conspiracy erupts, forcing them to hide their feelings. In the face of betrayal and suffering, they shield one another, clinging to love amidst the storm.

name: Den noh Coil
plot:
Den-noh Coil, Coil — A Circle of Children, is a Japanese science fiction anime television series depicting a near future where semi-immersive augmented reality technology has just begun to enter the mainstream. The series takes place in the fictional city of Daikoku, a hotbed of AR development with an emerging city-wide virtual infrastructure. It follows a group of children as they use AR glasses to unravel the mysteries of the half real, half Internet city, using a variety of illegal software tools, techniques, and virtual pets to manipulate the digital landscape.

Den-noh Coil, in development for over a decade, is the series director debut of Japanese animator Mitsuo Iso. It premiered on NHK Educational TV on May 12, 2007. Due to the animators involved in its production and its unusually high-profile television broadcast time slot, Den-noh Coil was highly anticipated.

plot:
The city's academies are divided into their own districts and are considered mostly independent.

The General Student Council acts as a governing board to manage the academies as a whole. However, the group's ability to govern has come to a halt since the mysterious disappearance of the General Student Council president. Countless issues have begun to surface throughout Kivotos in the absence of the president's leadership.

To avoid disaster, the General Student Council requests assistance from the Federal Investigation Club, otherwise known as Schale. In fact, Schale is the city's newest club and the last to be approved before the president's disappearance.

To accomplish its task, Schale relies on the guidance of a Sensei who can help them resolve the incidents around Kivotos.

name: ATRI   My Dear Moments
plot: In the near future, a sudden and unexplained sea rise has left much of human civilization underwater. Ikaruga Natsuki, a boy who lost his mother and one of his legs in an accident some years earlier, returns disillusioned from a harsh life in the big city to find his old countryside home half-swallowed by the sea. Left without a family, all he has to his name is the ship and submarine left to him by his oceanologist grandmother, and her debts. His only hope to restore the dreams for the future that he has lost is to take up an opportunity presented to him by the suspicious debt collector Catherine. They set sail to search the sunken ruins of his grandmother's laboratory in order to find a treasure rumor says she left there. But what they find is not riches or jewels; it is a strange girl lying asleep in a coffin at the bottom of the sea, Atri. Atri is a robot, but her appearance and her wealth of emotions would fool anyone into thinking she's a living, breathing human being.
cast: Kensho Ono, Hikaru Akao, Minami Takahashi, Yoshimasa Hosoya, Yoko Hikasa

name: Atri My Dear Moments
plot: In the near future, a sudden and unexplained sea rise has left much of human civilization underwater. Ikaruga Natsuki, a boy who lost his mother and one of his legs in an accident some years earlier, returns disillusioned from a harsh life in the big city to find his old countryside home half-swallowed by the sea. Left without a family, all he has to his name is the ship and submarine left to him by his oceanologist grandmother, and her debts. His only hope to restore the dreams for the future that he has lost is to take up an opportunity presented to him by the suspicious debt collector Catherine. They set sail to search the sunken ruins of his grandmother's laboratory in order to find a treasure rumor says she left there. But what they find is not riches or jewels; it is a strange girl lying asleep in a coffin at the bottom of the sea, Atri. Atri is a robot, but her appearance and her wealth of emotions would fool anyone into thinking she's a living, breathing human being.
cast: Kensho Ono, Hikaru Akao, Minami Takahashi, Yoshimasa Hosoya, Yoko Hikasa
